pages.explanation_text: 8단계, 8페이지 단계입니다. 한 직선 위에 있지 않은 서로 다른 세 점은 단 하나의 평면을 결정한다는 기본 공리로부터 두 직선의 교점·평행선 및 수직 관계를 단계별로 연역하는 원리가 완성되는 단계입니다. 이때 꼭 기억해야 할 점은, 평면기하에서는 만나지 않는 두 직선이 무조건 평행하지만, 3차원 공간에서는 만나지도 않고 평행하지도 않은 '꼬인 위치'가 존재하므로 반드시 한 평면 위에 있는지 먼저 확인해야 합니다!

narrations.en: Step 8 (Page 8). This is the stage where the principle of deducing step by step the intersection, parallel line, and perpendicular relationship of two straight lines is completed from the basic axiom that three different points that are not on a straight line determine only one plane. What you must remember at this time is that in planar geometry, two straight lines that do not meet are unconditionally parallel, but in three-dimensional space, there are 'skew lines' that neither intersect nor are parallel, so you must first check whether they are on the same plane!

narrations.en: Step 13 (Final Step): The visual proof is complete! Starting from the starting condition of 'There is a plane parallel to the given plane through a point that is not on the given plane' given the basic axioms and positional relationships of points, straight lines, and planes in three-dimensional space, which was the starting condition, a reference plane containing the given points and straight lines is set, and through auxiliary lines that reduce spatial relationships to congruent/parallel relationships on the plane by lowering the intersection and perpendicular lines, according to the axioms of space geometry and the plane determination conditions, 'Passing through points that are not on the given plane, Parallel planes exist.' The key point to remember here is that in planar geometry, two straight lines that do not meet are unconditionally parallel, but in three-dimensional space, there are 'skew lines' that neither intersect nor are parallel, so you must first check whether they are on the same plane!
